{{Top|leg}}
A '''Gasifier''' was a mining tool used in the [[Mining/Legends|mines]] of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]]. It used a high-energy beam to turn rock into [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]], and then sucked the plasma up into a [[Carbonite nanofiber]] tube that sent the plasma to the surface of the planet; the gas was then vented into the atmosphere.
